The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                  | Type                                                                                                         | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `type`                    | `"NavigationBar"`                                                                                            | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                           |
| `compact`                 | `boolean`                                                                                                    | No       |         | Change appearance of navbar as compact in desktop view                                                                   |
| `validateOnForward`       | `object`                                                                                                     | No       |         |                                                                                                                          |
| `validateOnForward.page`  | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Yes      |         | Which pages should be validated when the next button is clicked. Allowed values: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `validateOnForward.show`  | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Yes      |         | List of validation types to show                                                                                         |
| `validateOnBackward`      | `object`                                                                                                     | No       |         |                                                                                                                          |
| `validateOnBackward.page` | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Yes      |         | Which pages should be validated when the next button is clicked. Allowed values: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `validateOnBackward.show` | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Yes      |         | List of validation types to show                                                                                         |
